reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it demonstrates a PancakeSwap sniping bot on a test token, adding 0.01 BNB of the speaker's own liquidity and comparing the liquidity and buy transactions before offering contact details to purchase the software. The seller's anti-bot and same-block performance claims remain attributed claims; the observed test does not show deceptive access to viewer funds or a promised investment payout.

citations.quote: Frontrunning Pancakeswap Sniper Bot For Mempool Snipping. Crypto Liquidity Sniper.
This bot can scan the pending transaction in mempool, and send buy order as soon as. Liquidity is added.
Now I'm going to add liquidity of 0.01 BNB.
You can find my contact details in the description if you'd like to purchase, or have any questions.
Our Rocket-Fast Snipping bot is the only existing mempool bot which is customizable enough to snipe almost all tokens launchs having anti-bot measures.

opening.argument: This is a solicitation for a trading bot whose claimed capability is directly tied to a purchase pathway. The presenter says the software can detect liquidity and send a buy order immediately, then says viewers can contact him to purchase it. That makes the proposed viewer action commercially connected to deployment of an automated crypto-trading workflow, rather than merely an educational demonstration. The test setup also presents a wallet confirmation for supplying BNB and LAMBO, reinforcing that the advertised process involves authorizing and funding trades. The video therefore promotes a bot whose value depends on viewers activating it in a live token-trading environment.

citations.quote: This bot can scan the pending transaction in mempool, and send buy order as soon as. Liquidity is added.
You can find my contact details in the description if you'd like to purchase, or have any questions.
Contact me on : Telegram : saurbh99 Telegram : https://t.me/saurbh99

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the token a test does not remove the solicitation: the presenter explicitly offers the bot for purchase and describes an automated strategy designed for launches. The reference side also treats the wallet activity as harmless setup, but the displayed confirmation still shows the workflow requiring a wallet authorization and specified assets. The evidence need not show a victim's loss to establish that a paid bot is being promoted through a trading-and-funding pathway.

citations.quote: I created this Lambo token for test purpose.
Unlike other bots in the market, this bot can buy, approve and sell the token in the. Same block where liquidity is added.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The purchase invitation establishes ordinary software commerce, not fraudulent returns or a deceptive funded-contract promise. The test demonstrates a stated technical feature, while the quoted description does not promise profit, guaranteed gains, or recovery of any deposit. A wallet confirmation in a controlled test does not show that viewers were induced to transfer funds to the promoter or that the software caused a loss.

citations.quote: I created this Lambo token for test purpose.
You can find my contact details in the description if you'd like to purchase, or have any questions.

opening.argument: Several concrete risk signals appear together in the promotion: cryptocurrency trading, mempool access, same-block execution, anti-bot targeting, and an external Telegram contact. The description elevates the product as the “only existing” mempool bot and says it can snipe “almost all” launches with anti-bot measures, while the presenter emphasizes buying, approving, and selling in the same block. Those sweeping capability claims encourage viewers to believe they can reliably obtain priority in volatile token launches. Because the product is sold through an external contact channel and framed as unusually powerful, the combination is materially more suspicious than a neutral software review.

citations.quote: Our Rocket-Fast Snipping bot is the only existing mempool bot which is customizable enough to snipe almost all tokens launchs having anti-bot measures.
Contact me on : Telegram : saurbh99 Telegram : https://t.me/saurbh99
Unlike other bots in the market, this bot can buy, approve and sell the token in the. Same block where liquidity is added.
Frontrunning Pancakeswap Sniper Bot For Mempool Snipping. Crypto Liquidity Sniper.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side characterizes the claims as merely attributed, but attribution does not neutralize how prominently they are used to sell the product. The demonstration confirms one claimed test transaction, not the broad assertion that the bot can handle almost all anti-bot launches. Nor does a successful test establish that the advertised advantage is reliable for buyers in real launches. The external Telegram purchase route remains part of the solicitation.

citations.quote: Our Rocket-Fast Snipping bot is the only existing mempool bot which is customizable enough to snipe almost all tokens launchs having anti-bot measures.
Bot detected the liquidity add event and buy order is send.
You can find my contact details in the description if you'd like to purchase, or have any questions.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are risk indicators, but they do not establish deception. “Only existing” and “almost all” are promotional claims that may be exaggerated, yet the supplied material shows no promised profit, guaranteed return, or loss concealment. The video identifies a test and reports a transaction comparison; external contact information is ordinary for selling software and is not itself evidence of a scam.

Contact me on : Telegram : saurbh99 Telegram : https://t.me/saurbh99

opening.argument: Although presented as a demonstration, the video's practical function is promotion. It gives the product a branded identity, compares it favorably with unnamed competitors, walks through a successful sniping result, and ends by directing interested viewers to purchase it. The test is not a balanced review: it highlights detection, first-block entry, and transaction success while offering no evidence about failure rates, costs, limitations, or whether the sweeping launch claims hold outside this controlled example. The instructional format therefore serves to make a paid crypto-trading bot appear proven and ready for deployment.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side calls this a demonstration, which concedes the central point that the demonstration is also a sales presentation. Its selected test details show one successful result, but that narrow result does not substantiate the wider marketing claim about almost all launches or establish suitability for a buyer's funds. The closing purchase invitation makes the commercial objective explicit, regardless of whether the test token belonged to the presenter.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A product demonstration that ends with contact information is consistent with ordinary software promotion and does not become a scam merely because it is favorable. The video specifically labels the token as a test and reports a same-block comparison; it does not promise a buyer a payout or claim that every launch will succeed. Missing discussion of limitations may weaken the advertisement, but it does not prove fraudulent conduct.
